definition: a flour mixture you can knead or roll
description: In a rustic kitchen a young woman and an older woman shape pale balls of dough and set them in rows on a baking tray dusted with flour. The older woman opens the oven and they slide the trays of raw dough inside. Later the oven is opened again and trays of golden baked croissants come out steaming, filling the table.

en.question: What are the two women doing?

phrases: beim Anblick der Croissants nach Luft schnappen
